name: 17146-sharegpt-bamba9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine. This architecture is not V1-capable at this commit, so the engine runs V0 and every default quoted here is a V0 default.
architecture: hybrid state-space + attention decoder (BambaForCausalLM). 32 layers, of which 3 are attention and 29 are Mamba2 mixers; hidden 4096, vocab 128256, declared context window 4096; 9.78e9 parameters, F16, ~19.6 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000 equal to max_requests, so all 1000 requests are offered at once and none is resubmitted; 900 s safety cap, no warmup and no cooldown.
workload: ShareGPT V3 unfiltered cleaned split, 1000 single-turn prompts, materialised as `configs/data/sharegpt-1000-bamba.jsonl` -- 215201 prompt tokens (mean 215.2, median 83, max 997) and 198343 output tokens (mean 198.3, median 145, max 863), longest request 1765 tokens end to end. Each row sets max_tokens to its own conversation's reply length with ignore_eos, so every request emits exactly that many tokens; greedy decoding (temperature 0); `request_format: plain`, since this is a base checkpoint behind a completions-shaped payload.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on a 9-billion-parameter hybrid model, serving 1000 short conversational prompts at once on one GPU.
launch:
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
